comment: Slow away and home okay on debut. Settled closer and found enough to break through at Pakenham. Seems progressive.
Cost $60,000. Same sire as Stretan Ruler. Dam's only runner unplaced on debut. Close third in a 22/5 Flemington jumpout.
Covered ground just off speed from barrier 11 on debut, sticking on well for second. This is harder. Place claims.
Same sire as Point Barrow. Dam has one winner from two to race. Came from off speed and ridden out for 14/5 trial win.
Cost $300,000. Same sire as Autumn Glow. Dam has three winners from four. Ridden out for third in a 19/5 jumpout.
Cost $200,000. Same sire as Royal Patronage. Dam has one winner from three. Close up in a 22/5 jumpout.
Resuming. Backed from $4.40 to $3.80 on debut, holding ground after settling just off pace. Won 15/5 jumpout.
Lived up to his jumpouts with a comfortable debut win in heavy ground. Faces a stiffer test but is worth thought.

Settled second fresh and kept going to score comfortably. Competitive in first campaign. May have improved.
Freshened since tiring over 1600m. Lame at previous. Three-length third at latest 1400m run. Place hope.
Slow away and closed off solidly at Bendigo. Conceded too big a start at previous. Likely to be running on again.
Should have finished a lot closer two back. Home okay (but hung in) when not far away latest. Rise in trip may suit.
Just missed when dropping in class last Sunday. Covered ground and faded at previous. Runner-up in three of four this prep.
Settled second fresh, going away to score easily. Dominant on synthetic at only second-up run. Can contend.
Dropped in trip at the Bool and closed well enough to score on a heavy track. Held ground in a race won by the leader at previous.
Went to the lead in a change of tactics and kept rolling last time. Caught wide at previous. Won on debut. Not out of it.
Shared the lead latest and didn't finish off in a race set up for the closers. Settled behind speed when runner-up prior.
Drifted back in both runs this time in, finishing four lengths away each time. Was held up at latest. Prefer as a place hope.
Drifted back fresh, passing a few in the run home. Drops in weight with the rise in class. Easy maiden winner only run this trip.
On-pacer back in trip after being run down as favourite on a heavy track. Led when fourth to the in-form Seafall two back.
Held up on the turn when placed fresh. Had her chance latest. Hasn't won for more than two years. Place preferred.
Forgive latest (caught wide). Fought on okay. Likely to give them a start. Won't be far away, but place preferred.
Slow away second up and beat one home. Didn't do a lot first up either. Two-length third at this trip third up in spring.
Drifted back fresh, ninth of 10 but not beaten far. Has won three times second up, including this track/trip in this race last year.
No luck two back. Had his chance but not at best on soft going latest. Should be around the mark again.
Settled behind the pace and didn't finish it off third up. Okay in Adelaide two back. Needs to improve. Place preferred.
On-pacer who got out to a big lead but got run down latest. Caught on the line over 1400m here at previous. Will give a sight.
Crossed from barrier nine to share the lead and stick on without threatening at latest. Just outside the placings at previous two.
Hardy mare who has loomed up from just off the pace and found one better at past two. Should be competitive again.
English import. Won over this trip on a synthetic track on debut. Other four wins were over 2000m. Won a 14/5 trial.
